Message:
When I opened my eyes,
I found Alexandra
crumpled on the ground,
as if she were shielding me.

Her soul was being burned away,
yet the tips of her fingers
still clung to my arm,
refusing to let go.

You protected me...
until it made you
so tattered and broken...

Even though I am unworthy
of having a knight
as wonderful as you...

I enveloped her in a healing light,
and before long, her eyes opened.

“As I was trapped
in that vast,
endless darkness...
I heard your voice.
I heard you say,
‘I want you to live’...”

Her voice lifted me up
from the depths of darkness.

But, she suddenly knelt before me,
as if making a confession.

“Your wish...could not come true
due to my defiance.
So please...pass your judgement
upon me...”

No. You did nothing wrong.
The one who deserves
judgement is me.

For I sought to cast my life away
and bring my suffering to an end...
and dared call it atonement.

“I am a weak and foolish
sinner—a mere human.
That means I may
lose my way again.

Thus...I ask you...
Will you continue protecting me...
as my knight?
I need you... Alexandra.”

Not so that I can earn
atonement through death,
but to earn atonement...
through living.
